That works nicely. I typed "tra", saw my existing "travel" suggestion pop up under the field, picked it, saved — and the new bookmark showed up with the travel tag on it. And I like that it's suggesting tags I've already used so I'm not accidentally spinning up "travel" and "Travel" and "trips" that all mean the same thing. That was exactly my worry.

One thing I want to make sure works, since it's really the other half of tagging for me: what happens the very first time I use a brand-new tag that isn't in the suggestions yet? Say I type "florence" and I've never used it before — nothing will match. I'd still want to be able to just add it as a new tag right there and have it stick to the bookmark (and then show up as a suggestion next time). Can you show me that case? As long as I can both pick an existing tag and create a new one, the tagging feels right.
